subject.title: feat: add codexbar cookie refresh CLI command

question: Should CodexBar support this dedicated `cookie refresh` command, or should re-import extend the existing `cache clear --cookies` command instead?
rationale: VISION.md requires sign-off for new features and provider-auth/data-storage behavior, while the linked issue leaves the command shape open and has no maintainer approval.

options.title: Approve dedicated command
options.body: Keep `cookie refresh` after resolving browser-order, non-destructive failure, test, and proof blockers.

options.title: Extend cache command
options.body: Place re-import under the existing cookie-cache command family to avoid parallel credential-management surfaces.

options.title: Prefer in-app recovery
options.body: Decline the CLI surface and provide a visible provider-card re-import action with inline recovery.

recommendation.title: Approve dedicated command
recommendation.body: Keep `cookie refresh` after resolving browser-order, non-destructive failure, test, and proof blockers.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest repository-history and product-policy owner for approving a new auth/storage CLI surface.
